P4.note: Formatting contract appended to P3 (synthesis) and P5 (summary mode); no LLM node of its own — 'node' is null because it is never invoked standalone.

analyze_question.on_failure: retry once with stricter nudge, else classify out_of_scope + planner_degraded flag

contextualize_question.on_failure: degrade to the raw question, log contextualization_failed; the turn survives

synthesize_answer.on_failure: typed error -> visible error banner, never an empty answer

groundedness_check.on_failure: pessimistic default: treat the answer as ungrounded and trim claims

$comment: Prompt metadata contract (T8). Per prompt id: the minimum version the T9-T15 graph nodes require ('min_version'), the graph node that consumes it ('node'), and whether that node requests a structured (JSON-schema) output ('structured'). src/utils/prompts.py:required_version(id)/assert_min_version(id) enforce the floor; src/utils/mock_llm.py keys its scripted responses on this file's node names and structured flags instead of hardcoding them (ADR-005 scripted mode: 'prompt fingerprint (node name + schema presence)'). Temperatures mirror the per-task parameter policy in docs/adr/ADR-005-llm-gateway-and-params.md. P4 has no node of its own — it is an appendix to P3/P5.
